services.title: What We Can Do For You
services.subtitle: See if any of these sound familiar
cat1.question: Data scattered everywhere? Takes forever to find one file?
cat1.item1.title: Escape Spreadsheet Hell
cat1.item1.desc: Reports and reconciliations scattered across a dozen spreadsheets, copy-pasting until your eyes blur? We bring it into one system — enter data once, sync everywhere.
cat1.item2.title: Connect Your Existing Systems
cat1.item2.desc: Accounting software and ERP that don't talk to each other, so you type the same record three times? We connect them — enter once, sync everywhere.
cat1.item3.title: Cloud Backup for Your Data
cat1.item3.desc: Critical files living on one computer or someone's USB drive? We move it to the cloud — safely backed up, accessible anytime.
cat2.question: Don't know your numbers until month-end? Missing contract deadlines?
cat2.item1.title: Dashboards Your Boss Can Actually Read
cat2.item1.desc: Waiting all month for someone to compile the numbers? Get a live dashboard instead — no more manual spreadsheet roundups.
cat2.item2.title: Automatic Document Recognition
cat2.item2.desc: Manually retyping every invoice and receipt, one at a time, mistakes and all? AI reads the documents and fills the data in for you.
cat2.item3.title: Automatic Reports & Reminders
cat2.item3.desc: Forgetting contract renewals or low stock until it's too late? The system emails and notifies you automatically.
cat3.question: Drowning in customer messages? On call nights and weekends?
cat3.item1.title: AI Customer Service
cat3.item1.desc: Same questions every day, phone ringing off the hook? AI handles the first round, 24/7, so your team only deals with what really needs a person.
cat3.item2.title: LINE Official Account Bot
cat3.item2.desc: Customers messaging on LINE around the clock? A bot answers common questions and takes bookings or orders automatically.
cat3.item3.title: Company Website
cat3.item3.desc: Customers look you up and find nothing, or a ten-year-old site that doesn't work on phones? We build one that actually looks professional.
cat3.item4.title: Get Found on Google
cat3.item4.desc: Built a website but nobody can find it in search? Basic SEO so customers actually see you.
cat4.question: Typing the same form two or three times? Stuck in the back-and-forth?
cat4.item1.title: Move Forms Online
cat4.item1.desc: Sales reps still texting in paper forms for someone to retype? Move it online — enter once, no retyping.
cat4.item2.title: Booking & Scheduling System
cat4.item2.desc: Juggling appointments by phone, LINE, and walk-ins, and things keep double-booking? Let customers pick their own slot online.
cat4.item3.title: Inventory Management
cat4.item3.desc: Never sure what's actually in stock without digging through spreadsheets? Real-time, accurate numbers, with low-stock alerts.
cat4.item4.title: Multi-Location Data Sync
cat4.item4.desc: Every branch keeping its own books, HQ waiting on everyone to report in? We connect it all — HQ sees it live.
cat5.question: Too much repetitive work, but hiring more people isn't in the budget?
cat5.item1.title: Let AI Do the Repetitive Work
cat5.item1.desc: Data analysis, filing, first-pass reviews eating up your team's time? Let AI take the first pass so the same headcount gets more done.
cat5.item2.title: Automated Web Data Collection
cat5.item2.desc: Manually checking competitor prices or market rates one by one? We automate the collection and keep it updated for you.

scene.title: Your data is scattered, and nobody knows which copy is right
scene.subtitle: Every spreadsheet hides a risk. Watch them get crossed out, fold into one system, then open each one up.
scene.status.chaos: Data scattered across files and people
scene.status.burst: Hover each mark to see the problem; click the centre system to enlarge
scene.detail.burst: Hover a title to see the problem; click for our fix
scene.s1.desc: The same customer and item typed into every file; fix one, forget the other
scene.s1.fix: Enter once and it syncs everywhere. One source of truth, nothing out of step.
scene.s2.desc: One editor at a time. Conflicts become new copies and nobody knows which is current
scene.s2.fix: Everyone works online at once. There is only ever one current version, and no files to send.
scene.s3.desc: VBA macros pile up; when the author leaves nobody dares touch them, and every change costs money
scene.s3.fix: Modular features with documentation and clear specs, not tied to one person, so upkeep costs stay predictable.
scene.s4.desc: To see one customer's history you open ten files and press Ctrl+F in each
scene.s4.fix: Global search: type a name and get orders, quotes, shipments and contact notes in one list.
scene.s5.desc: Past ten thousand rows it lags, and the month-end roll-up takes a whole day
scene.s5.fix: A database aggregates live. Reports open with current numbers, with no month-end wait.
scene.s6.desc: Once the file is shared everyone sees everything; it is all locked or all open
scene.s6.fix: Roles decide who sees which fields and amounts. Sales cannot see cost; the warehouse cannot see prices.
scene.s7.desc: Who changed a price, and what it was before, cannot be found
scene.s7.fix: Field-level history: who changed what, when, and the values before and after.
scene.s8.desc: A deleted formula or a misaligned paste, usually found only when a customer complains
scene.s8.fix: Input is checked as you type. Rules live in the system, so they cannot be overwritten by accident.
scene.s9.desc: Out of the office there is no current stock or order view; you phone the office
scene.s9.fix: Open it on a phone or tablet any time. Stock and orders update live, so you can answer the customer on the spot.
scene.s10.desc: Contract expiry and stock-outs live in someone's head or on a sticky note, and get missed
scene.s10.fix: Expiry, shortage and to-do alerts go out by email or LINE automatically.
scene.f1.name: Custom ERP
scene.f1.desc: Built around your process. You do not change how you work to fit the software.
scene.f2.name: Order system
scene.f2.desc: Quote, order, ship and collect in one flow, with every order's status in view.
scene.f3.name: Inventory
scene.f3.desc: Live stock, safety-stock alerts, and batch and expiry tracking.
scene.f4.name: Chatbot + RAG
scene.f4.desc: A bot that answers from your own documents, SOPs and product data. Customers and staff can ask directly, and answers cite their source.
scene.f5.name: LINE bot
scene.f5.desc: Check stock, look up orders and take bookings in LINE, with no new app for customers.
scene.f6.name: Live reports
scene.f6.desc: Sales, stock and receivables on the owner's phone, with no waiting for someone to compile them.
scene.f7.name: Roles and audit
scene.f7.desc: Role permissions, hidden fields and a full change history, so every action can be traced.
scene.f8.name: Document AI
scene.f8.desc: Photograph or scan invoices and delivery notes and have them read into the system.
scene.f9.name: Multi-site
scene.f9.desc: Head office and branches work from the same live data, with no waiting for reports.
scene.f10.name: API links
scene.f10.desc: Connect e-invoicing, accounting software and other platforms, with no manual exports.
scene.f11.name: Auto alerts
scene.f11.desc: Expiry, shortage and pending approvals reach people by email or LINE.
scene.f12.name: Import and backup
scene.f12.desc: Bring in your old Excel files in one go, with cloud backups that have been tested for restore.
scene.status.core: System enlarged. Click a feature tag; click the centre again to go back
scene.detail.core: Click a feature to read about it
scene.coreExpand: Zoom in on the AMAD Smart system
scene.coreCollapse: Go back and show all spreadsheets
scene.f13.name: Global search
scene.f13.desc: Type a name and get orders, quotes, shipments and contact notes in one list, with no ten files to open.
scene.s11.desc: One file mailed back and forth; everyone holds a different copy and nobody knows which is newest
scene.s11.fix: One live copy, every change logged. No more "final" in the file name.
scene.s12.desc: Only they understand the logic, it lives on their laptop, and it all resets the day they leave
scene.s12.fix: Data and process live in the company system, not with one person. Handover is just a permission change.
scene.s13.desc: Passed around by email and chat; one lost USB stick leaks it, one dead laptop loses it
scene.s13.fix: Stored in one place with permissions and automatic backup; who viewed what is always traceable.
scene.s14.desc: A dozen sheets copy-pasted into one report every month, two days gone and it still does not add up
scene.s14.fix: Data flows into reports as it is entered; slice it any way you want, no month-end overtime.
scene.s15.desc: Different columns, units and wording per person; it needs cleaning before it can be merged
scene.s15.fix: Fields and options are defined once and enforced on entry, so data is consistent by design.
scene.s16.desc: Accounting, chat and web orders each live apart; people carry data between them by hand
scene.s16.fix: APIs and integrations let orders, notifications and accounting data flow on their own.
